messages.subject: Q4 roadmap review — Thursday 10:00
messages.snippet: I pulled the revised scope into the deck and trimmed the wish list to what we can ship before the holidays.
messages.bodyHtml:
Hi Avery,

I pulled the revised scope into the deck and trimmed the wish list to what we can realistically ship before the holidays. The two open questions are:

  1. Do we keep the shared-inbox beta in Q4, or move it to January?
  2. Is the analytics export a launch blocker, or can it follow a week later?

I'd like to settle both on Thursday so we can lock the plan. I'll send an agenda Wednesday morning.

Thanks,
Elena

Elena Vasquez
VP Product · Meridian
messages.bodyText: Hi Avery, I pulled the revised scope into the deck and trimmed the wish list to what we can realistically ship before the holidays. The two open questions are: Do we keep the shared-inbox beta in Q4, or move it to January? Is the analytics export a launch blocker, or can it follow a week later? I'd like to settle both on Thursday so we can lock the plan. I'll send an agenda Wednesday morning. Thanks, Elena Elena Vasquez VP Product · Meridian

messages.subject: Re: Q4 roadmap review — Thursday 10:00
messages.snippet: The deck looks tight. I'd keep the shared-inbox beta in Q4 and move the analytics export to early January.
messages.bodyHtml:
Elena —

The deck looks tight. I'd keep the shared-inbox beta in Q4 and move the analytics export to early January, as long as support has the macro library ready.

I'll bring both questions to Thursday.

Avery
